description: Cancel a job. Jobs in status 'waiting', 'dispatched' or 'running' can be cancelled (a running job's upstream execution is stopped too). Use when the user changes their mind, or when you submitted the wrong job. Completed, failed, or already-cancelled jobs cannot be cancelled.
